verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS project-tracking tool with an API, so the axis applies. The evidence covers views, fields, workflows, templates, the GraphQL API, the MCP server and the CLI. None of it documents a sandbox, staging, or isolated test environment, or any dry-run mode that avoids touching production project data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
